ar.title: حساء الفول النابت

steps.n2: يُسخن السمن أو الزيت وتُضاف إليه المستكة، ثم يُضاف الماء ويُترك حتى يغلي.
steps.n3: يُضاف الفول والليمون والبصلة المقشورة، ويُترك على نار متوسطة حتى ينضج مع إزالة الريم كلما طفا، ويُضاف الملح قبل تمام النضج.
steps.n4: يُضاف البقدونس المفروم ويغلي الحساء خمس دقائق، ثم يُتبل ويُقدم ساخناً.

en.title: Sprouted Fava Bean Soup

steps.n1: Peel, clean and wash the sprouted fava beans.
steps.n2: Heat the ghee or oil, add the mastic, then add the water and bring it to a boil.
steps.n3: Add the beans, the lemon and the peeled onion and cook over medium heat until tender, skimming off the scum whenever it rises; add the salt shortly before the beans are done.
steps.n4: Add the chopped parsley and boil the soup for five minutes, then season and serve hot.

legacySteps: Peel, clean and wash the sprouted fava beans.
Heat the ghee or oil, add the mastic, then add the water and bring it to a boil.
Add the beans, the lemon and the peeled onion and cook over medium heat until tender, skimming off the scum whenever it rises; add the salt shortly before the beans are done.
Add the chopped parsley and boil the soup for five minutes, then season and serve hot.
